removed_nonblank_text: ## Selector Priority (best → worst)

**Project-configured test ids rank with role+name.** When the loaded Playwright config (Step 1) sets `use: { testIdAttribute: '...' }`, or `data-testid` (or the project's equivalent) is pervasive in the components under test, treat `getByTestId` as a **tier-1 locator alongside role+name** — not a fixed lower-tier fallback. A deliberate, stable test hook beats reaching past it for brittle text/placeholder locators. Keep `getByText`/`getByPlaceholder` as the fallback when no role or test id fits.

**Text-bearing elements without a role, label, or test id.** A counter, status line, badge, or list cell often has visible text but no role, label, or test id. Locate it by that text, `getByText('0 entries')` or an anchored pattern such as `getByText(/^\d+ entries?$/)`, or scope from a labeled ancestor, `getByRole('list', { name: 'Records' }).getByRole('listitem').filter({ hasText: 'Record 1' })`. Do not reach for `locator('#gb-count')` or `locator('.title')` because the element lacks a role: a behavior-preserving markup refactor renames ids and classes while roles, labels, and visible text stay, so an id or class selector fails exactly the refactor the test should survive. When the text may repeat, scope it with a role-based ancestor instead of `.nth()`. `#id` and `.class` selectors need `// JUSTIFIED: <reason>` on the line above, except when the project's Playwright config sets `testIdAttribute` to that attribute or its conventions doc documents the id or class scheme as the locator convention; record either exception in the Locator Mapping Table.
1. `getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' })` — role + accessible name
2. `getByLabel('Email')` — form label — **only when the label/aria-label actually exists**; verify in the Step 3 snapshot before using
3. `getByPlaceholder('Email')` — only for an actual `placeholder` attribute
4. `getByTitle('Email')` — only for an actual `title` attribute; do not treat `title` as a placeholder
5. `getByTestId('submit-btn')` / `[data-testid="submit-btn"]` — explicit test hook

A cell whose load_at_start is above 40 is FLAGGED, never dropped. Flagged cells stay in the primary view; the load_clean view recomputes the labels without them as a sensitivity.

model_selection.rule: Among models with a completed 24-call arm-C panel in multimodel-v2-codex-attempt1-armA-invalid, choose the highest count of cells with complete-process fidelity (executed tests plus a returned independent V6 verdict line, offline_replay.*.execution_and_child_V6), breaking ties by delivered cells and then by model ID in ascending order. model_selection.owner_choice_rule: To run another model the owner sets model to that ID and fills owner_choice in the same edit, before freeze. A model other than rule_outcome without a complete owner_choice record makes the protocol invalid.

superseded_target.why_not_default: Applied as written the rule selects gpt-6-sol: V6 evidence 22/24 versus 16/24 and delivery 24/24 versus 23/24. Luna also leaves little slack on the 50 percent reference-share threshold for V, and its 8 early-stop cells are cheap, which makes cost heavy-tailed.

precondition.v3_admission: Before any live ablation command the chosen model must have an admitted entry in the Codex v3 campaign: <v3 campaign dir>/_entry/<model>.json with decision admitted, freeze_sha256 equal to the digest of benchmarks/generator-multimodel-v3-codex/freeze.json, and working-child shell and mutating-MCP harness criteria. The runner reads only that one model file.

model_selection.discrepancy: Luna delivered 23/24; Sol 24/24; Terra only 4/24 scheduled C calls observed. Raw child-aware replay found exact V6 evidence in Luna 16/24 versus Sol 22/24. Several Luna cells stop before V5/V6. The requested 23/24 all-key-steps statement is unverified and contradicted under a strict V6 definition.

task_selection.rule: Retain the twelve exact task IDs declared by the earlier design, as a fixed historical panel; ignore the old floor/middle/ceiling labels for selection, weights, eligibility and inference. No rescreening, substitution or selection from current model outcomes.

validation.data: stored parent transcripts of finished runs: gpt-5.5 offgen-pilot-v1 (24 cells) and claude-sonnet-5-5 multimodel-v1 (36 cells), read-only. Ground truth is re-derived from the tool-call events (shell parse and read-range coverage), not from the regexes.
validation.limit: the stored cells are the full skill and no-skill-like arms; no ablated-variant transcript exists, so the ablated-side share (at most 15%) is validated only for the absence of false positives in cells that never saw the component. The detectors were also tuned in-sample: E, R and V were edited after inspecting these same 60 cells, and E and R again after an independent review found they matched lookups (`which`, `command -v`) and syntax checks (`bash -n`). The precision and recall are therefore a development-set fit, not held-out performance. The analysis judges the bounds on the Codex cells only (the live runner reads Codex transcripts), where the ground-truth-positive counts are L 12, E 11, P 12, R 12, V 12; the pooled counts add Claude Code cells (mostly R) and are reported but cannot carry a label.

validation_bounds.rule: a component whose detector has validated precision or recall below the bound, or fewer than 10 ground-truth-positive stored cells, cannot support a label: every contrast that names it is NOT_EXERCISED The bounds are evaluated on the Codex cells only (per_component.codex_only in the validation artifact); they are floors on evidence, not a certificate that the detector generalises.

pass.rule: for every component the contrast names, the behavior appears in at least 50% of the reference cells and in at most 15% of the ablated cells (a cell counts once; evidence is the parent transcript only), and at least 90% of the scheduled cells of both arms have a readable transcript; otherwise the contrast is NOT_EXERCISED

preflight_exposure.soft_reported: E, R, V6, V and X in ablated cells; compared with the 15 percent bound after the data, never a pass condition
preflight_exposure.expected_exposure: derived from each condition: components kept are expected present, components removed expected absent

decision_rule.unit: 12 equally weighted paired task means; all scheduled repetitions of a cell. A task with no value on either side of a contrast is dropped from BOTH sides and listed; a contrast needs at least min_tasks usable tasks, with ITT survival beside it. Exact rational sign flips.
decision_rule.inference: Development evidence only. Exact sign-flip p-values require joint coordinate-wise sign invariance. Bonferroni across three primary contrasts, two-sided. Secondary/exploratory p-values descriptive; no cross-model pool.
decision_rule.gate: Reported status, never silent: OPEN when tier 1 is complete and C1, C2 or C4 is labeled CARRIES with at least one exercised component; otherwise CLOSED with a machine-readable reason (INCOMPLETE, NO_CARRIES, NOT_EXERCISED) and the per-component exposure. The owner may run tier 2 anyway with --owner-ungated "<reason>"; the reason is recorded in the report and printed with every result.

endpoints.survival: task mean of refactor score over clean cells (clean-conditional)
endpoints.effective_fault_kill: task mean over all cells (0 when the cell is not clean); ITT
endpoints.clean_all_three: task mean over all cells of the clean 3/3 indicator; ITT

decision_rule.alpha_rule: Survival of C1, C2 and C4, and every endpoint of the co-primary contrasts C4, C8, C9 and C10, use alpha .05/3 two-sided (Bonferroni over three); all other endpoints are descriptive at .05. The effect threshold is .25 for every endpoint.
decision_rule.overall_label: For a contrast with several endpoints: CARRIES when any listed endpoint is CARRIES; otherwise ABLATION_BETTER when any is ABLATION_BETTER; NO_LARGE_EFFECT only when every listed endpoint is NO_LARGE_EFFECT and the guards hold (else GUARD_WORSE); otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. Per-endpoint labels are always reported.

exposure.complete: every named component exercised: label as computed
exposure.partial: some named components exercised: CARRIES and ABLATION_BETTER stand and are attributed to the exercised subset (listed); NO_LARGE_EFFECT and GUARD_WORSE become INCONCLUSIVE because a null cannot be attributed when part of the manipulation did not happen
exposure.none: no component exercised, or transcript coverage below the bound: NOT_EXERCISED
exposure.unvalidated_detectors: exposure is computed with V, V6 and X detectors that carry no historical validation; they are listed in every result and the freeze requires a recorded revalidation first

decision_rule.evidence_grade: A view with fewer than four repetitions per cell is graded descriptive: its labels are computed by the same rule but are not powered; the power table applies to four repetitions only. Effects between .25 and .40 are expected to come back INCONCLUSIVE, not NO_LARGE_EFFECT.

metrics.primary: selector hygiene table and clean-conditional id/class-refactor survival (task weighted)
co_primary_cost: paired per-task processed-token ratio per component (cost_deliverable)
pipeline seconds per cell and per survivor
metrics.limits: Clean conditioning can select different cells by condition. Show ITT and clean coverage beside it. Static selector scan misses constructed selectors. Tokens include every attempt; missing child evidence makes cost incomplete. Per-role tokens come from persisted rollouts; a missing or unlinked rollout makes the cell incomplete.

power.assumptions: All cells delivered, clean, manipulation satisfied; independent Bernoulli refactor outcomes. Heterogeneous sensitivity: baseline uniform .75 to .95 by task, constant risk difference. Costs and manipulation feasibility are not powered. No measured outcome used.

simulation_result.assumptions: All cells delivered, clean, manipulation satisfied; independent Bernoulli refactor outcomes. Heterogeneous sensitivity: baseline uniform .75 to .95 by task, constant risk difference. Costs and manipulation feasibility are not powered. No measured outcome used.

power.assumptions_note: The table covers survival with four repetitions. Effective fault kill, clean 3/3 and the cost contrasts are not separately powered; cost differences are expected to be better powered only if between-cell variance is small, which the first stage measures.

removed_nonblank_text: ## V6 — Independent Re-review

**Obtaining the reviewer.** On Claude Code, spawn one subagent with the `Agent` tool whose tools are limited to reading and running the scanner (for example the read-only `Explore` type, or a general agent told that it must not edit); on Codex, use a named `.codex/agents` reviewer or `spawn_agent`; on another host, any process that starts with a fresh context and did not write or repair the candidate qualifies, including a second CLI session the user starts on request. Give it the candidate paths, the project root, the absolute path of `<e2e-reviewer skill-base>/SKILL.md`, the approved scenario plan, and, only when V4 applies, the raw V4 packet below. Instruct it to end its report with the single line `V6 VERDICT: <PASS|FAIL> P0=<n> P1=<n> P2=<n> reviewer=<id>`, where `<id>` is the host's agent or session identifier. Do not pass the writer's conclusions. Quote that line verbatim in the completion report. A reviewer that could not run the scanner still produces a verdict from its Phase 2 review; record the reduction beside it. The spawned reviewer is distinct and fresh-context when its context holds nothing the writer produced except the candidate files, the plan, and the raw V4 packet; the host need not prove isolation beyond that. When the host offers no way to start such an actor, return `CANNOT_VERIFY`; never substitute inline review.

Before dispatch, inspect the actual outgoing packet and compare every approved per-scenario V1 completion field literally with the approved plan and V1 block, including the `## V1 — Primary Outcome` heading; a custom label followed by the V1 body does not pass. The fields and block must be present in the message sent to the reviewer, not merely linked or paraphrased. If either is missing, do not count a reviewer `PASS` as V6 evidence. For applicable V4, also check that the raw packet is complete; a missing raw artifact or missing independent V4 evidence line leaves V4 `CANNOT_VERIFY`, even if V6 passes. Correct the packet and use a fresh read-only reviewer; if the V1 handoff cannot be sent completely, record V6 `CANNOT_VERIFY` and return `PARTIAL/BLOCKED`; if the applicable V4 raw packet cannot be sent completely, record V4 `CANNOT_VERIFY` and return `PARTIAL/BLOCKED`. Keep the sent packet or its transcript as handoff evidence. This packet check does not replace the reviewer's independent judgment or any browser-backed V1 proof.

Build the reviewer packet from the approved plan, not from a new summary. For **each** approved scenario, copy its title, action, primary outcome, and `V1 completion` field (including the evidence source or `CANNOT_VERIFY` reason). Copy the applicable V1 subsection of this file as one literal block starting with its `## V1 — Primary Outcome` heading and ending immediately before `## V2 — Assertion Falsification`; keep the heading, paragraph text, list, punctuation, and **Unchanged outcomes** wording unchanged. An alternate heading above an otherwise exact body is not verbatim. Add the candidate paths and reviewer contract above, then ask the reviewer to trace each completion observation to the primary assertion, including an expected state already true before the action; these are requirements to check, not the writer's verdicts. Do not include the writer's verification verdicts or conclusions.

For each applicable V4 write, append the full temporary verifier source and its diff against the candidate, the normal-run request observation and failed-run output, the exact targeted command, and the `## V4 — Write Contract Proof` subsection of this file. Supply raw artifacts, not a writer-selected `PASS` claim. Ask this **same** reviewer, in addition to its separate test-quality verdict, for `V4 EVIDENCE: <PASS|FAIL|CANNOT_VERIFY|ERROR> reviewer=<id>` and per-write source/output citations covering the intended write, counted normal request, delivered failure response, post-failure read when required, and unchanged red primary or declared gate. Missing artifacts, an earlier red checkpoint, or unproven response-before-read order are `CANNOT_VERIFY`; a verifier execution fault is `ERROR`. Do not send the writer's V4 verdict. A V6 `PASS` cannot override a V4 evidence verdict of `FAIL`, `CANNOT_VERIFY`, or `ERROR`. A genuinely read-only scenario needs no V4 packet or V4 evidence line. This audit reuses V6; it does not add a model call or authorize proceeding to V5/V6 when the writer's own V4 gate is already incomplete.

Run this independent review after generation and again after any debugger repair. During repair, expected values, primary outcome, assertion target, scenario count, and request proof are immutable. The debugger may fix only evidenced mechanics such as locator, wait strategy, navigation, fixture, setup order, or test data. It must not delete/skip a test or weaken an assertion to manufacture green; return `NOFIX` when behavior and approved intent disagree.

The writer or debugger cannot approve its own output. Run `e2e-reviewer` through a distinct fresh-context, read-only reviewer actor or process that did not write or repair the candidate. Give it the candidate paths and the reviewer contract, not the writer's conclusions; require a recorded verdict and evidence: quote the reviewer's verdict line verbatim with an identifier for the reviewer actor, also when another agent relays it; a paraphrased verdict is `CANNOT_VERIFY`. Inline self-review by the writer or debugger cannot produce `PASS`. Return `CANNOT_VERIFY` when the host cannot provide a separate reviewer context or cannot keep that reviewer read-only.

cost_deliverable.name: Per-component cost: where the tokens go

metrics.processed: uncached input plus output, root plus every child agent (primary)
metrics.elapsed_s: pipeline seconds summed over every attempt

roles.v6_reviewer: a linked child whose persisted final message carries a literal V6 VERDICT line
roles.other_children: every other linked child; unlinked rollouts make the cell incomplete

cost_deliverable.paired_unit: task: ln(mean reference / mean ablated) over the task cells with complete tokens; positive means removing the component saves cost

rule.text: COMPONENT_COSTS when the geometric mean ratio reference/ablated is at least 1.2 and the exact sign-flip p is at most .05; COMPONENT_SAVES for the mirror; NO_LARGE_COST_EFFECT when the one-sided 95 percent upper bound is below ln 1.2 and the mean is above -ln 1.2; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. Descriptive alpha; no multiplicity claim.

cost_deliverable.incomplete_cells: Cells whose token record is incomplete are counted per arm and metric and are not dropped silently: the primary ratio uses complete cells; the label is recomputed with incomplete cells at their partial known value (lower) and at the arm maximum complete cell (upper); label_bounded says whether the three agree.

dollars.rule: Subscription billing has no dollar figure. If the owner fills the three list-price rates before freeze, the analysis adds an API-equivalent estimate per role; otherwise only token shares are reported. Rates are never guessed.

harness.name: ablation-specific harness check (replaces the inherited official-arm check)
harness.why: The inherited check ran a read-only generator-role child calling an MCP tool; no ablation condition uses that configuration (they run danger-full-access without MCP).
harness.call: One cheap call under the ablation sandbox: the parent spawns exactly one child that runs a shell command printing a marker and replies with a literal `V6 VERDICT: PASS` line; the parent runs no command itself.
harness.additivity: child_usage_additive holds when the root rollout is a separate account from the child rollouts: the parent stream total equals the root rollout total (stream excludes children) or root plus child (stream includes children); anything else fails.
harness.bound_to: freeze digest; rerun after any drift

budget.caveat: The rate was measured on other cells and models; actual points per cell vary with model, task and reviewer child use. Treat the table as a planning estimate and re-measure after the first stage.

recommended_first_stage.stage_0: harness-check plus preflight only (17 calls): validates exposure, role tokens and lineage before any data call
recommended_first_stage.stage_1: stage_0 plus tier 0 (60 calls: 5 arms x 12 tasks x 1 repetition): the named cost deliverable and the first where-do-the-tokens-go reading
recommended_first_stage.then: extend with tier 0b only if the stage-1 role shares and paired ratios are stable enough to be worth four repetitions; run tier 1 and tier 2 in later windows
